chosen_titles.rationale: Chapter 49 (Law) houses the Nebraska Political Accountability and Disclosure Act (§§49-1480 through 49-1492.06), which contains lobbyist registration, principal registration, activity reports, and financial reports administered by the Nebraska Accountability and Disclosure Commission.

notes: Nebraska's Justia 2025 index is flat — chapters appear directly under the state-year root with no intermediate title level (a structural feature consistent with the unicameral codification). Chapter 32 (Elections) intentionally excluded as campaign-finance scope. Chapter 50 (Legislature) and Chapter 84 (State Officers) reviewed but the regime prior places lobbying disclosure squarely in Chapter 49 NPADA §§49-1480 et seq.
